title.narrative: FLC: The platform of like-minded people
PYM: Vammaishanke: The platform of like-minded people

description.narrative: This project is a follow-up to the previous project funded by Office of the Ambassador of Finland to Tajikistan (interventiokoodi: 67102219) and a second step in the development of a favourable economic climate for women with disabilities and other vulnera ble women. As part of the project it is planned to work with successful girls and women with disabilities members of their self-help groups girls and women from low-income families orphans and single women. The method is used to prevent the segregation of women with disabilities and the inclusion of other women.In the first component of the project six one-day information workshops are planned to provide information to the task force on state programmes and strategies and international documents adopted by Tajikistan:-National development strategy for the period of 2020-2030-National strategy for enhancing the role of women in the republic of Tajikistan for 2011-2020-Medium-term development program of Tajikistan for the period of 2016-2020-UN convention on t he elimination of all forms of discrimination against women-UN convention on the rights of persons with disabilities.Clippings on the above mentioned documents relating to women´s issues entrepreneurship protection and promotion of rights will be distribu ted during the information process. It is planned for 90 beneficiaries.In the second component of the project it is planned to organize the platform of like-minded people -camp for 20 participants which will last 5 days. The platform will involve HR-expert s from Finland (Ms. Mavluda Peiponen/Yyldyz ry.) and from Kazakhstan. The camp will hold intensive educational courses on leadership business planning marketing funding and fundraising. At the end of the project there will be organized a roundtable at the regional level with the participation of representatives of state structures banks micro credit organizations public organizations and local governments.

Vammaishanke the platform of like-minded people on jatkoa hyvin onnistuneelle ITÄ-21 tukemalle vammaishankkeelle v. 2018. Vammaishankkeen avulla luodaan suotuisaa taloudellista ympäristöä vammaisille naisille ml. muille haavoittuville naisryhmille kute n orvoille alhaisen toimeentulon omaaville naisille ja sinkuille. Projektin tarkoituksena on estää vammaisten ja vähäosaisten naisten erottautuminen muista naisista. Ensimmäisenä asiakokonaisuutena organisoidaan em. ryhmille kuusi yhden päivän koul utustilaisuutta koskien valtion ohjelmia ja strategioita sekä hyväksyttyjä kansainvälisiä sopimuksia (mm. National Development strategy for the period of 2020-2030 UN convention on elimination of all forms of disrimination against women UN convention on the rights of persons with disabilities) joissa erityisesti keskitytään vammaisten naisten ja vähäosaisten asemaan yrittäjyyteen ja oikeuksiin. Koulutustilaisuuksiin kutsutaan 90 osallistujaa mutta tietoa levitetään informaatiokirjein myös muill e tietoa tarvitseville tahoille.Toisena asiakokonaisuuteena organisoidaan viisipäiväinen The platform of like-minded people -tapahtuma 20 (hakemuksien perusteella valituille) osallistujalle. Tapahtumaan kutsutaan myös ihmisoikeuksien ekspertit Suomesta (Mavluda Peiponen/Yyldyz ry) ja Kazakhstanista. Tapahtuman aikana organisoidaan intensiivisiä kursseja mm. johtajuudesta markkinoinnista rahoitusmahdollisuuksista ja varainkeruusta.Tapahtuman lopuksi organisoidaan koko ryhmälle pyöreän pöydän keskust elu improving the conomic climate for women of their vulnerable segments of the population johon kutsutaan puhujia valtion eri laitoksista pankeista luottofirmoista sekä paikallishallinnosta.
